description: This file contains functions related to setting up security configurations and installing hooks for SecurityGroups within a SugarCRM module. It primarily defines methods to initialize configuration options and to register hooks that trigger upon specific UI events.

methods.name: install_ss
methods.description: Initializes default security-related configuration options in the global $sugar_config and global variables, then saves the configuration to a file, and finally calls a function to install hooks.

methods.name: installSSHooks
methods.description: Registers a set of logic hooks related to SecurityGroups for various UI events by requiring the hook handler file and calling a registration function for each hook.
